item.title: Re: Ms. G. Lass
item.content:encoded:
Summoned via PM:

Hi there Angryman22. Let’s take a look at your concept.

It starts off promising, but I’m struggling to connect the various anomalous together. For example, what does a survivor of a glass factory explosion have to do with “a strong hatred for transparent objects”? Furthermore, why is it that when they’re “exposed to even a very small amount of oxygen, they will engulf in flames reaching a temperature of 4000K”?

You appear to be adding these anomalous properties without consideration for purpose or reason. At best, this sounds like a possible body horror scip if you manage to delve deeper into the psychology of the humanoid. Tell us more about who Georgine Lass was/is. Why is she behaving the way she is after the explosion? At worst, however, this scip sounds like your typical Peter Parker-gets-bitten-by-a-radioactive-spider-and-becomes-a-superhero sort of story. Even then, you need to flesh out the character’s motivations and goals and tell us why she’s behaving as such.

If you decide to revise the concept / respond below, do drop me another PM and I’ll take another look. For now, all the best!

item.title: Re: Ms. G. Lass
item.content:encoded:
Hm. I'm going to make a really radical suggestion here: this should be a tale. This feels like you're really trying to tell this deeply personal, highly emotional tale of what happens to a Foundation researcher assigned to work with this, and the effect it has on their mental health; and I think that could really work, particularly considering how easily this SCP can escape. But not as a SCP: where the therapy details and the intimate personal feelings of the researcher would feel extremely out of place. Instead, doing this as a tale, likely from the perspective of the researcher but possibly from the perspective of they're therapist or something, would really allow you to convey the emotional turmoil a lot better.

Equally, you're welcome to see if a different reviewer would appreciate this more: it's very possible the idea just doesn't sit right with me personally rather than it being flawed.

When exposed to even a very small amount of oxygen, they will engulf in flames reaching a temperature of 4000K. When this happens, they begin to run around erratically, usually burning though everything and everyone it comes close too.

Why does this happen? It's not how glass works, and also like…there's oxygen in the air which means pre-containment, they'd have almost certainly been on fire constantly.

item.title: Ms. G. Lass
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre Emotional, sort of

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXX has no bodily orifices and all their skin is replaced with glass. The rest of them is hollow. They also possess regenerative capabilities, to the extent where they can regenerate 1/10th of their body in a minute. They were created in a glass factory explosion in Toulouse, France. They were formerly known as Georgine Lass. They were the only survivor. They have a strong hatred for transparent objects due to this, and will attempt to crack, break, or otherwise damage them when in line of sight. When exposed to even a very small amount of oxygen, they will engulf in flames reaching a temperature of 4000K. When this happens, they begin to run around erratically, usually burning though everything and everyone it comes close too.

Central Narrative: Due to the severe flammability, all methods that foundation has thus far have been found not heat resistant enough, hence ineffective. It follows the logs of a pair of containment engineers working, getting pressured, mishaps, everything, as they try to create a containment chamber capable of containing them as they posed a severe containment risk and breached containment several times. They eventually do succeed.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: There will be 2 versions of the file, 1 before the success, and 1 after. The before one will have an O5 notice stating “All Containment Engineer Personal at Site X, unless told otherwise by a Foundation Employee with Level 4 Clearance or above, must focus all research, time, and resources to the creation of a containment chamber for SCP-XXX. The budget for containment has been increased to [Large Amount Of Site’s Local Currency].”

Additional Notes: It's not just containment breaches 24/7, but more 1 monthly give or take. I will also have a recontainment procedure so it's not like it takes days to recontain.
